2638-3510-5929-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
2638-3510-5929-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1385-1957-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3703-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3703-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

628-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-3773-6972--112.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

728-5058-7396.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

851-1308-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

625-1651-2709-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Mechanics to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Orcish Mechanics by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Mechanics.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-2060-2921-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2609-5195-7496.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
2609-5195-7496.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy by paying {W} due to its affinity for creatures.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
2292-6972-7233.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1912-2060-5140-7267.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-7267.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2919-3490-4659-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2919-3490-4659-6458.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

413-1636-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
413-1636-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station trigger, untapping all creatures and Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

1494-6755.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ouroboroid triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2792-4823-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2792-4823-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Timeless Witness and Great Whale, targeting Timeless Witness
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Great Whale.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Timeless Witness and Great Whale tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5263-5686-6243.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1368-2051-3518-5911.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
1368-2051-3518-5911.description:
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}.
Flubs triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Life from the Loam, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Life from the Loam.
Flubs triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Lion's Eye Diamond.
Repeat.

4067-4365-5742-5743.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

261-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1987-2187.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Possessed Skaab exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
372-1987-2187.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2506-3839.easyPrerequisites: any creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
2506-3839.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying its mana cost.
When Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Hero with haste.
When the Changeling Hero token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Hero until the token Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Changeling Hero.
The token Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2104-4423-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-4423-5913.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

331-1110-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1171-1656-4762-5215.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1171-1656-4762-5215.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Garth One-Eye to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Krosan Archer's ability by paying {G} and discarding Garth One-Eye, giving Necrotic Ooze +0/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2232-2421-2459-4050-5300.notablePrerequisites: Rograkh and You have enough mana to pay for Rograkh's commander tax, if applicable.
2232-2421-2459-4050-5300.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Akiri to your hand from the battlefield.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {W}.
Cast Akiri by paying {R}{W}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Akiri enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

3362-3388.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Moritte of the Frost
3362-3388.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Moritte of the Frost's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

215-2757-3000-4541.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight Treasures.
You control a basic Forest.
215-2757-3000-4541.description:
Activate eight Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens and eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1369-3814-3995.notablePrerequisites: Two lands that tap for blue.
1369-3814-3995.description:
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Horseshoe crab.
Pay {U} using Quicksilver Elemental to target Argothian Elder.
Tap Quicksilver Elemental to untap lands for at least {C}{U}.
Pay {U} to untap Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat.

92-2063-2298.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than forty.
92-2063-2298.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying 1 life, regenerating it.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
